links.outcome: Agreement between baseline and second-month ChatGPT-4o responses on complex EGM interpretation scenarios
links.effect: Accuracy was 30% (Scenario C) and 25% (Scenario D); baseline vs second-month agreement was fair (κ = 0.285 and 0.3), showing limited consistency.
links.quote: In Scenarios C (30%) and D (25%), accuracy was lower, and agreement between baseline and second-month responses remained fair (κ = 0.285 and 0.3, respectively), indicating limited consistency in complex decision-making tasks.

screen.reason: The study tests the impact of providing varying levels of contextual clinical information on ChatGPT-4o's accuracy and reliability when interpreting intracardiac electrograms.
